DependencyShort.description: A dependency coordinate: `org:name:version` (Java), `org::name:version` (Scala), `org:::name:version` (Scala full cross-version). The `:version` may be omitted (`org:name`, `org::name`) when a Maven BOM in `boms:` supplies it.

exclusions.description: organization in key and module name(s) in value. example: {"org.scala-sbt" : "util-logging_2.13"}, or {"org.scala-sbt" : ["util-logging_2.13", "util-cache_2.13"]}

isSbtPlugin.description: an sbt plugin. `org:name` is an sbt 1 plugin. `org::name` is an sbt 1 plugin for a scala 2.12 project and an sbt 2 plugin (`name_sbt2_3`) for a scala 3 one, so one line serves a plugin built for both.

scanForAnnotationProcessors.description: Scan resolved-`dependencies` JARs for `META-INF/services/javax.annotation.processing.Processor` and add matches to javac's `-processorpath`. `true` fails when none are found, `if-present` runs whatever is there, as javac does without a processor path. Default off (explicit opt-in).

annotationProcessors.description: Processor-only deps. Resolved separately and added to javac's `-processorpath`; never on the runtime classpath. Composes with `scanForAnnotationProcessors`.

annotationProcessorOptions.description: `-A<key>=<value>` flags passed to javac. Visible to all configured processors (per JSR 269).

ecjVersion.description: ECJ (Eclipse Compiler for Java) version. If set, uses ECJ instead of javac.

KotlinJs.description: Kotlin/JS settings. Only `moduleKind` is read; the other fields on this block in bleep's model are not wired to anything yet and are deliberately not listed here.

moduleKind.description: Module format the Kotlin/JS linker emits. Default `commonjs`; `--module-kind` on `bleep link` overrides it. Not honoured for test links, which are always `umd` because bleep's Kotlin/JS test runner loads the output with `require`.

moduleName.description: Name of the emitted module, and of the file it lands in. Defaults to the project name with `-` replaced by `_`.

sourceMap.description: Emit a `.js.map` beside the module. Defaults to on for a debug link and off for `--release`; `--source-maps` / `--no-source-maps` override both.

sourceMapPrefix.description: Prefix prepended to source paths inside the source map. Unset means the compiler is not told about one at all.

sourceMapEmbedSources.description: Whether the source map carries the sources themselves. Default `never`; `always` embeds every source, `inlining` embeds only sources that were inlined.

generateDts.description: Emit TypeScript declarations (`.d.ts`) next to the module. Default false.

kspVersion.description: KSP-side version suffix (e.g. "1.0.29"). Bleep concatenates with `version` to form the full coord `com.google.devtools.ksp:symbol-processing-aa-embeddable:<kotlin>-<ksp>`. Required when `symbolProcessors` is non-empty or `scanForSymbolProcessors` is true.

scanForSymbolProcessors.description: When true, scan resolved-`dependencies` JARs for `META-INF/services/com.google.devtools.ksp.processing.SymbolProcessorProvider` and add matches to KSP's processor classpath. Default off (explicit opt-in).

symbolProcessors.description: KSP processor-only deps. Resolved separately and passed as the trailing positional classpath to the standalone `KSPJvmMain` runner — never on the project's runtime classpath. Composes with `scanForSymbolProcessors`.

symbolProcessorOptions.description: `<key>=<value>` flags passed to KSP via `-processor-options=`. Visible to every configured processor (no per-processor scoping).

skipStdlib.description: no Scala standard library from a repository: neither the one bleep adds nor one a dependency brings in transitively. For the project that IS the standard library, and for projects that reach it through `dependsOn` on such a project.

compilerProject.description: compile with the Scala compiler built by this project (`name` or `name@crossId`) instead of fetching `version`. Its runtime classpath is the compiler and its own classes the zinc compiler bridge, so name the bridge project. Built first; never on this project's classpath.

sbtPlugin.description: an sbt plugin: for sbt 1 when `version` is 2.12, for sbt 2 when it is 3. Published as `name_2.12_1.0` or `name_sbt2_3`, the names sbt looks plugins up by.

jsRuntimeClassNameMapper.description: Scala.js: what `getClass.getName` reports at run time. Every name is kept, then each rename applied in order: `regex` (Java syntax) replaced by `replacement` (`$1` for a group).

jsTestScripts.description: Scala.js test projects: JavaScript files loaded, in order, as plain scripts before the linked test program, each named as a resource of the project (a file in exactly one of its resource folders, generated ones included).

jsModuleInitializers.description: Scala.js: static methods the linked program calls on start, in order, after the main class or the test bridge. Without `args` the method takes no parameters; with `args`, even empty, it takes `Array[String]`.

name.description: a combination of JVM and version in this format `graalvm-java17:22.1.0`

index.description: the default index is the coursier index, located at https://github.com/coursier/jvm-index/raw/master/index.json . If you need to use a JVM which is not there, you can specify another index here

folder.description: path of project relative to build root. can be omitted if it is just the project name

dependsOn.description: projects this one compiles against: `name`, and bleep picks among its cross versions (same cross id, else same Scala version and platform, ...), or `name@crossId` for exactly that cross version

source-layout.description: selects a standardized set of source directories

sbt-scope.description: changes src/scala to source/main/scala and so on

sources.description: additional set of source directories. you should set `sbt-scope` and `source-layout` first

resources.description: additional set of resource directories. you should set `sbt-scope` and `source-layout` first

sourcegen.description: additional set of source directories. you should set `sbt-scope` and `source-layout` first

stamp.description: Values bleep derives from the build and writes into this project's artifact, as bleep-stamp/<project>.properties on the runtime classpath and in the jar. 'dynver': the version bleep publish would use (bleep publish --version X stamps X). 'git-sha': the commit, even on a clean tag. 'project-digest': this project's content digest, the one the remote cache keys on — not free, a plain compile computes no digests. 'build-digest': a portable digest of the whole build. Stamps never reach the compiler and are never part of the cache key, so they are recomputed on every build at no cost to caching.

boms.description: Maven BOMs (dependencyManagement imports, e.g. io.quarkus:quarkus-bom:3.37.4). Applied as version constraints to every dependency resolution this project participates in — its own, and that of any project that (transitively) dependsOn it.

jars.description: Unmanaged jar files to add to the classpath. Paths are relative to the build root directory.

maxConcurrentSuites.description: Ceiling on how many of this project's test suites run at once. Default 1 — suites run one at a time. Its reach depends on testFork: in per-project mode (the default) it only speeds up JUnit Platform suites — the JUnit engine runs that many of the project's JUnit classes at once inside the one shared fork, scheduled with its @ResourceLock/@Execution graph. sbt-interface frameworks (ScalaTest, MUnit, utest, Specs2, ScalaCheck, weaver, …) always run sequentially in per-project mode, so a value > 1 on an sbt-only project has no effect (bleep warns); use testFork: per-suite to run sbt suites concurrently, a fork each. In per-suite mode it bounds how many forks run at once and is unbounded by default. The machine-wide governor caps the total across all projects either way.

testFork.description: Where this project's test suites run relative to the JVM hosting them — the fork granularity. 'per-project' (the default) runs every suite in one forked JVM (maven's forkCount=1 reuseForks=true), so a booted application or shared fixture is reused across suites and suites run sequentially; raise maxConcurrentSuites to run JUnit Platform classes concurrently inside it (sbt frameworks stay sequential). 'per-suite' forks a JVM per suite for OS-level isolation, and is how you run sbt suites concurrently; maxConcurrentSuites then bounds how many forks run at once. Unset = per-project.

testFrameworks.description: Escape hatch to name an sbt test-interface Framework class (implements sbt.testing.Framework) that bleep does not auto-detect; normally unset. The class is instantiated and its fingerprints drive discovery, so it must be a Framework, not a suite. JUnit Platform engines are NOT named here — they are found through the platform's own SPI whenever a JUnit runtime is on the classpath.

testExclude.description: Suites `bleep test` never runs in this project: suite FQDN glob patterns with `testTags`'s syntax (`*` within a class-name segment, `**` spans dots). Applied before `--only` and `--exclude`, which cannot bring one back.

testTags.description: Tag → suite FQDN glob patterns. Filters tests at the suite-dispatch boundary, so this works for any test framework. `*` matches within a class-name segment; `**` spans dots. CLI: `bleep test --only-tag slow --exclude-tag flaky`.

libraryVersionSchemes.description: Version scheme to use for specific modules. Same syntax as a normal dependency, but the version need to be one of these values: "early-semver", "pvp", "semver-spec", "always", and "strict".

ignoreEvictionErrors.description: Controls how dependency eviction conflicts are handled. 'yes' ignores all eviction errors, 'warn' converts them to warnings, 'no' fails on eviction errors. Default is 'no'.

postCompile.description: rewrite this project's compiled classes before anything else sees them. The compiler writes a private directory; the script gets it as `--from`, an empty `--to` to fill with the complete output, `--classpath` and `--input`s, and only a successful run becomes the project's classes.

className.description: the class; for a Scala `object`, its name without the trailing `$`

project.description: the project whose `main` rewrites the compiled classes (`name` or `name@crossId`). Built first; never on this project's classpath.

inputs.description: projects whose classes the script reads, passed as `--input <name>=<dir>`. Built first; never on this project's classpath.

sourceGlobs.description: extra directories the generator reads, relative to the folder of THIS project (the one declaring `sourcegen`), not the script project. They are real inputs: a change under them re-runs the generator, changes the remote-cache key, shows up in `bleep build invalidated`, and wakes up `--watch`. Despite the name there is no glob matching, entries are plain directory paths. The source and resource folders of the script project and its dependencies are already inputs and do not need listing. See https://bleep.build/docs/concepts/sourcegen#what-counts-as-an-input

inputs.description: projects whose output the generator reads (their compiled classes, by path from the build model), `name` or `name@crossId`. Built before it runs, a change to their classes re-runs it, and never on this project's classpath because of this.

PublishConfig.description: Publishing configuration. Presence marks a project as publishable. All fields merge through templates.

enabled.description: Set to false to opt out of publishing while inheriting other publish fields from a template

sonatypeProfileName.description: Sonatype staging profile name (defaults to groupId)

Repository.description: A Maven, Ivy, or local repository for dependency resolution

name.description: Resolver name for referencing in publish commands and auth config

uri.description: Repository URI (for maven and ivy types). Supports artifactregistry://, github://, gitlab:// schemes

resolvers.description: Additional Maven/Ivy repositories for dependency resolution. Supports private repos with artifactregistry://, github://, gitlab:// schemes.

remote-cache.description: Remote build cache configuration for S3-compatible storage. Credentials go in ~/.config/bleep/config.yaml or BLEEP_REMOTE_CACHE_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID/BLEEP_REMOTE_CACHE_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY env vars.

uri.description: S3 bucket URI (e.g., s3://my-cache/builds) or S3-compatible endpoint (e.g., http://localhost:9000/bucket/prefix)
